envelope.id: Event identifier (uuid); the key for deduplication
envelope.schemaVersion: Version of the payload schema of this type
envelope.sequence: Journal sequence number; an identifier, not the replay order
envelope.cursor: Opaque replay cursor of the event
envelope.workspaceId: Workspace of the entity; null for tenant-level events
envelope.actorId: Principal who acted; null for the core itself
envelope.iamActorId: IAM identity of the actor, when there is one
envelope.sessionId: Work session, when there is one
envelope.payload: Data of the event, by the schema of (type, schemaVersion)

agent.retired.description: An agent was retired: stopped, binding revoked, history kept.

revision.description: The last revision of the agent

reason.description: Reason given; credential-shaped material redacted, cut to the limit

releasedClaims.description: Active claims of the agent released to the queue

agent.revision_published.description: A new immutable revision of an agent spec was published (CP-ADR-0073 §2).

previousRevision.description: Null for the first revision of the key

executorKind.description: Null for an identity without placement

permissionsChanged.description: Identity (roles, permissions, capabilities) differs from the previous one

agent.state_changed.description: The desired state or replica count of an agent changed; no new revision.

previousState.description: Null when the agent is first published

agent.status_changed.description: The observed state of an agent changed: phase, reason, node or revision.

reasonCode.description: Why it is not running, e.g. no_matching_node

api_key.break_glass_issued.description: A short-lived break-glass key was issued from the host shell (CP-ADR-0065).

api_key.created.description: An API key was issued to a principal.

approval.approved.description: The approval was approved by an eligible principal.

outcomeStatus.description: pending when the task type declares outcomes for this decision (CP-ADR-0061)
pending when the task type declares outcomes for this decision (CP-ADR-0061)

comment.description: Decision comment; credential-shaped material redacted, cut to the limit

channel.description: Channel the decision came through when it was not a direct API call (e.g. telegram); null for a direct call

approval.cancelled.description: The pending approval was cancelled; nobody decides it any more.

approval.outcome_deferred.description: An outcome action waits for something (e.g. a skill invocation) before continuing.

approval.outcome_executed.description: The outcome actions the task type declares for the decision were executed.

approval.outcome_failed.description: An outcome action failed; the remaining actions stay for replay.

approval.rejected.description: The approval was rejected by an eligible principal.

outcomeStatus.description: pending when the task type declares outcomes for this decision (CP-ADR-0061)
pending when the task type declares outcomes for this decision (CP-ADR-0061)

comment.description: Decision comment; credential-shaped material redacted, cut to the limit

channel.description: Channel the decision came through when it was not a direct API call (e.g. telegram); null for a direct call

approval.requested.description: A decision was requested from a principal or from the holders of a role.

requiredRoleId.description: Set when any holder of the role may decide

gate.description: A gate holds the task's claim and completion until decided

requiredRoleId.description: Set when any holder of the role may decide

gate.description: A gate holds the task's claim and completion until decided

workspaceId.description: The approval's workspace, else its task's workspace

taskPublicId.description: Public id of the task, e.g. TASK-000123

comment.description: Request comment; credential-shaped material redacted, cut to the limit

artifact.content_purged.description: The bytes of an artifact were removed by an administrator; the record stays.

reason.description: Reason given; credential-shaped material redacted, cut to the limit

objectDeleted.description: False when other artifacts or uploads still need the object

artifact.content_read.description: The bytes of an artifact were handed out (CP-ADR-0072 §5).

forTaskId.description: Receiving task when read as its input

runId.description: The reader's running run on that task, if any

sizeBytes.description: Size of the stored content; null without one

typeVersion.description: Version of the registered artifact type it was checked against

artifact_type.created.description: An artifact type version was created (CP-ADR-0072).

attention.feedback_recorded.description: A principal judged an item of its attention list (CP-ADR-0071).

principalId.description: Whose attention list the item was on

rule.description: The rule that raised the item, as ruleKey@version

created.description: false when the verdict replaced an earlier one

hasComment.description: The comment itself stays with the feedback row

capability.assigned.description: A capability was assigned to the principal.

capability.revoked.description: A capability was revoked from the principal.

claim.expired.description: The lease of a claim ran out.

claim.released.description: The claim on a task ended: completed, released, cancelled or superseded.

context_adapter.rebuilt.description: The memory context adapter was rewound to rebuild its projection.

context_adapter.redriven.description: The memory context adapter was redriven past a parked event.

delegation.created.description: A human delegated permissions to an agent.

event_journal.archived.description: Journal events were moved to the archive (ADR-0038).

goal.updated.description: Goal attributes or its status changed.

iam_binding.created.description: An IAM identity was bound to a local principal (CP-ADR-0053).

iam_binding.revoked.description: An IAM binding was revoked; the identity no longer enters.

iam_binding.updated.description: The permissions of an IAM binding changed.

knowledge.pack_registered.description: A domain knowledge pack version was registered.

knowledge.packs_configured.description: The knowledge packs of a workspace tree were configured.

knowledge.snapshot_reconciled.description: A knowledge snapshot was reconciled into the memory service (CP-ADR-0060).

principal.created.description: A principal (human, agent or service) was created.

project.config_revision_activated.description: A configuration revision became the active one.

project.config_revision_created.description: A new configuration revision of the project was drafted.

project.created.description: A project was created on a workspace (ADR-0031).

project.external_reference_added.description: A reference to an external system was attached to the project (ADR-0047).

project.external_reference_updated.description: An external reference of the project changed.

project.status_changed.description: The project moved to another status.

project_template.created.description: A project template version was created.

project_template.deprecated.description: A project template version was deprecated.

role.assigned.description: A role was assigned to the principal, tenant-wide or in a workspace subtree.

role.created.description: A role was created, tenant-wide or in a workspace.

role.updated.description: A role was renamed or redescribed.

rule.evaluated.description: A work rule was evaluated against a trigger.

run.cancel_requested.description: Cancellation of the run was requested.

run.child.cancel_requested.description: Cancellation of the child run was requested.

run.child.launched.description: The run launched a child task under a handle (ADR-0046).

run.child.resolved.description: The child handle was resolved with the child's outcome.

run.child.started.description: A run of the child task started.

run.control_message.accepted.description: A control message for the active turn was accepted (ADR-0044).

run.handoff_prepared.description: The run prepared a handoff to another executor.

run.manifest_compiled.description: The effective harness manifest of the run was compiled (ADR-0043). No longer written since ADR-0073; kept for events already in the journal.

run.manifest_ephemeral_recorded.description: An ephemeral manifest change was recorded (ADR-0043). No longer written since ADR-0073; kept for events already in the journal.

run.started.description: An execution attempt started under a claim.

agentRevisionId.description: Agent revision the run goes by (CP-ADR-0073 §7); null for executors that are not registered agents

run.suspended.description: The run was suspended, e.g. to wait for a decision.

session.expired.description: A work session expired; its claims were released.

session.opened.description: A harness opened a work session.

skill.invocation_claimed.description: An executor took the invocation under a lease.

skill.invocation_requested.description: The core was asked to invoke a skill (CP-ADR-0056).

skill.invocation_retry_scheduled.description: The attempt failed with a retryable error; another one is scheduled.

skill.invocation_succeeded.description: The invocation finished; its result is an artifact.

skill.updated.description: The description or status of a skill version changed.

task.claimed.description: An executor claimed the task under a lease.

task.comment_added.description: A comment was added to the task.

task.completed.description: The task reached its completion status.

task.completion_work_executed.description: The completion work the task type declares was executed (ADR-0061).

task.completion_work_failed.description: An action of the completion work failed; the completion stands.

task.context_pack_recorded.description: The context pack assembled for the task on claim was recorded (CP-ADR-0064).

task.external_reference_added.description: A reference to an external system was attached to the task (ADR-0047).

task.external_reference_updated.description: An external reference of the task changed.

task.relation_added.description: A relation to another task was added.

task.relation_removed.description: A relation between tasks was removed.

task.updated.description: Task attributes or its status changed.

task.verification_failed.description: An acceptance check failed; the task went back to its executor or got blocked.

task.verification_started.description: A verification attempt of the task's acceptance checks opened (CP-ADR-0067).

task.verified.description: Every acceptance check passed; the task is complete.

task_type.created.description: A task type version was created (ADR-0048).

task_type.deprecated.description: A task type version was deprecated.

tenant.bootstrapped.description: The tenant was created with its first administrator.

work.reconciled.description: A rule updated, cancelled or completed the work it derived earlier.

workspace.member_added.description: A principal became a member of the workspace.

workspace.member_removed.description: A principal stopped being a member of the workspace.

workspace.moved.description: A workspace moved under another parent.
